description: This is a comprehensive unit test file for the PolicyPersistenceActor in a Java-based Akka actor system. It tests various CRUD operations, recovery scenarios, sequence number consistency, and command handling for policy persistence including policies, policy entries, resources, and subjects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of PolicyPersistenceActor, including CRUD, recovery, and sequence number correctness.

methods.name: tryToRetrievePolicyWhichWasNotYetCreated
methods.description: Tests retrieving a policy that has not been created yet, expecting a PolicyNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: createPolicy
methods.description: Tests creating a new policy and verifies correct response and state.

methods.name: modifyPolicy
methods.description: Tests modifying an existing policy and checks for correct update and revision increment.

methods.name: retrievePolicy
methods.description: Tests retrieving an existing policy and expects the correct policy version.

methods.name: sudoRetrievePolicy
methods.description: Tests the sudo retrieve operation which bypasses some access controls.

methods.name: deletePolicy
methods.description: Tests deleting a policy and ensures it cannot be retrieved afterward.

methods.name: createPolicyEntry
methods.description: Tests adding a policy entry.

methods.name: modifyPolicyEntry
methods.description: Tests modifying a policy entry.

methods.name: tryToModifyPolicyEntryWithInvalidPermissions
methods.description: Ensures modification with invalid permissions is rejected.

methods.name: modifyPolicyEntrySoThatPolicyGetsTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that modifying a policy entry that causes the policy to exceed size limits is rejected.

methods.name: removePolicyEntry
methods.description: Tests removing a policy entry.

methods.name: tryToRemoveLastPolicyEntry
methods.description: Tests attempting to remove the last policy entry, expecting invalid operation.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Tests adding a resource to a policy.

methods.name: modifyResource
methods.description: Tests modifying a resource linked to a policy.

methods.name: tryToModifyResource
methods.description: Tests invalid modifications of a resource.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Tests removing a resource from a policy.

methods.name: createSubject
methods.description: Tests adding a subject to a policy.

methods.name: modifySubject
methods.description: Tests modifying an existing subject.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Tests removing a subject from a policy.

methods.name: recoverPolicyCreated
methods.description: Tests actor recovery after creating a policy, ensuring state persists.

methods.name: recoverPolicyDeleted
methods.description: Tests recovery after a policy deletion.

methods.name: recoverPolicyEntryModified
methods.description: Tests recovery after modifying a policy entry and ensures event consistency.

methods.name: recoverPolicyEntryDeleted
methods.description: Tests recovery after deleting a policy entry.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectness
methods.description: Ensures the revision sequence number increments correctly after modifications.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectnessAfterRecovery
methods.description: Checks sequence number correctness after actor restart and state recovery.

methods.name: testPolicyPersistenceActorRespondsToCleanupCommandInCreatedState
methods.description: Validates cleanup command handling in initial state.

methods.name: testPolicyPersistenceActorRespondsToCleanupCommandInDeletedState
methods.description: Validates cleanup command handling after policy deletion.

methods.name: checkForActivityOfNonexistentPolicy
methods.description: Checks that non-existent policies correctly respond with a shutdown signal.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorFor
methods.description: Helper to create an actor for a specific policy entity.

methods.name: incrementRevision
methods.description: Utility to increment policy revision number.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Helper to terminate an actor and wait for it to stop.
